caps: Your grandmother hung | *MANGO LEAVES* over the door.
lines.tts: Your grandmother hung mango leaves over the door. She wasn't decorating.
It's called a toran, from torana, the Sanskrit word for a gateway.

caps: In the *BHAGAVATAM,* | little *DHRUVA* | left home crying.
lines.tts: In the Bhaagavatam, little Dhruv left home crying.

caps: When he came back, | *EVERY GATE* in the city
had *MANGO LEAVES,* | pots of water | and burning *LAMPS.*
lines.tts: When he came back, every gate in the city had mango leaves, pots of water, and burning lamps.
When Krishna came home to Dwaarka, every door wore a toranaa.

caps: The same leaves | crown the *KALASH* | at every puja.
lines.tts: The same leaves crown the कलश at every pooja.

caps: It says: | *SOMEONE WE LOVE* | is coming home.
lines.tts: So it was never decoration. It says, someone we love, is coming home.
Mango leaves, marigolds, or beads? What's on your door? Comment your state!

caps: *SEND* this | to the one who ties yours.
lines.tts: Send this, to the one who ties yours.
